reading.objective: Introduce the autumn collection as an object of desire and establish the house name.
reading.audience: Affluent fashion clients who read restraint as quality.

concept.idea: An eclipse of rust and gold, an aureole around a dark autumn sun, because Aurel means gold and the season is low light.
decisions: structure: weight sits at the foot in an oversized name, with the eclipse bleeding off the upper right so the dark ground stays as shape
read first: the eclipse, then the name overlapping its lower edge, then the season line
type: Bodoni Moda, a fashion Didone, set large and tight; Instrument Sans in small spaced capitals for everything else
colour: aubergine-black ground, ivory ink, one gold used only as a hairline ring, rust for the disc
forms: a solid rust disc and a thin offset gold ring, one hairline rule; nothing else
